steps.goal: Start a new sketch on the Top plane.
preconditions: A Part Studio is open and no tool dialog is active.

actions.target_description: The Top origin plane entry in the left feature tree.
actions.icon_description: A plane icon beside the label Top.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Top plane is highlighted in the canvas and feature tree.

actions.target_description: The Sketch button in the top Part Studio toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A small sketch/page icon with the visible label Sketch.
actions.semantic_action: Create a sketch on the selected Top plane.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch mode opens looking normal to the Top plane.

concise.text: Select the Top plane and start a sketch.

detailed.text: I will select the Top plane and open a new sketch on it.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the Top plane again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The control moved, so I will relocate it.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: Sketch mode did not open, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: A new sketch is active on the Top plane.
uncertainties: Toolbar positions may vary with window width.

steps.goal: Draw a circle centered on the sketch origin.
preconditions: A sketch is active on the Top plane and the origin is visible.

actions.target_description: The center-point Circle tool in the sketch toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A circle outline icon in the sketch geometry toolbar.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Circle tool is active and awaits a center point.

actions.target_description: The sketch origin where the red horizontal axis and green vertical axis intersect.
actions.icon_description: A small origin point at the crossing of the red and green axes.
actions.semantic_action: Place the circle center exactly on the sketch origin.
actions.expected_visible_result: A circle preview follows the pointer from the origin.

actions.ui_region: sketch canvas immediately right of the origin
actions.target_description: A blank point on the red horizontal sketch axis roughly 100 pixels to the right of the origin, creating a clearly visible circle without touching the canvas edges.
actions.expected_visible_result: A complete circle centered at the origin is visible.

concise.text: Draw a circle centered on the origin.

detailed.text: I will choose the circle tool, anchor its center to the origin, and set a visible radius.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the circle target again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The sketch view moved, so I will relocate the origin.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The circle was not created correctly, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: A circle centered at the sketch origin exists.
uncertainties: The exact visual scale depends on the current viewport.

steps.goal: Finish and accept the circle sketch.
preconditions: The centered circle is visible in the active sketch.

actions.ui_region: upper-right corner of the sketch dialog or toolbar
actions.target_description: The green checkmark button that accepts and closes the active sketch.
actions.expected_visible_result: Sketch mode closes and Sketch 1 appears in the feature tree.

detailed.text: I will accept the centered circle sketch.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the accept button again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The button moved, so I will relocate it.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The sketch did not close, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: Sketch 1 is committed and visible in the feature tree.
uncertainties: The accept control can appear in a floating sketch dialog.

steps.goal: Open Revolve using the circle sketch.
preconditions: Sketch 1 contains the centered circle and is committed.

actions.target_description: Sketch 1 in the left feature tree.
actions.icon_description: A sketch glyph beside the label Sketch 1.
actions.semantic_action: Select Sketch 1 as the revolve profile.

actions.target_description: The Revolve feature button in the top toolbar.
actions.icon_description: A curved rotational arrow around a profile.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Revolve dialog opens with Sketch 1 as its profile.

concise.text: Select the sketch and open Revolve.

detailed.text: I will select Sketch 1 and open the Revolve feature.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the Revolve tool again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The toolbar changed, so I will relocate Revolve.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The Revolve dialog did not open, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: The Revolve dialog is open with the circle sketch selected.
uncertainties: Revolve may be inside a toolbar dropdown on narrow windows.

steps.goal: Revolve the circle around its vertical center axis and accept the feature.
preconditions: The Revolve dialog is open and Sketch 1 is the selected profile.

actions.target_description: The empty Revolve axis selection field in the Revolve dialog.
actions.expected_visible_result: The dialog is waiting for an axis selection.

actions.target_description: The vertical green sketch center axis passing through the circle center and origin.
actions.icon_description: A vertical green construction axis through the origin.
actions.semantic_action: Choose the vertical center axis as the revolve axis.

actions.target_description: The green checkmark button that accepts the Revolve feature.
actions.icon_description: A green checkmark at the top of the Revolve dialog.
actions.expected_visible_result: The Revolve dialog closes and Revolve 1 appears in the feature tree.

concise.text: Use the vertical center axis and accept the revolve.

detailed.text: I will choose the vertical axis through the circle center, preview a full revolve, and accept it.

dynamic_corrections.retry: I will locate the center axis again.
dynamic_corrections.target_relocated: The view moved, so I will relocate the axis.
dynamic_corrections.validation_failed: The revolve preview is not valid, so I will pause.
dynamic_corrections.user_interrupt: You took control, so I will stop.

steps.expected_end_state: A completed 360-degree Revolve feature exists around the circle's center axis.
uncertainties: The axis color may vary when highlighted.
